# DJ Musta Music

> Uganda's #1 Free Music Streaming & Download Platform — https://djmusta.com

DJ Musta Music is Uganda's premier destination for streaming and downloading the hottest Ugandan music for free. The platform features kadongo kamu, gospel, afrobeat, dancehall, reggae, and all genres of Ugandan music.

## What We Offer

- Free music streaming and downloads for all visitors
- 200+ Ugandan songs across all genres
- 100+ Ugandan artists with dedicated profiles
- Genres: Kadongo Kamu, Gospel, Afrobeat, Dancehall, R&B, Hip Hop, Reggae, Nonstops, Traditional
- Music promotion services for Ugandan artists
- Artist verification and profile management

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://djmusta.com) — Discover and stream Ugandan music
- [New Music](https://djmusta.com/new-music) — Latest Ugandan songs
- [Top Songs](https://djmusta.com/top-songs) — Weekly chart of most played songs
- [Top Artists](https://djmusta.com/top-artists) — Featured Ugandan musicians
- [Gospel Music](https://djmusta.com/gospel) — Ugandan gospel and praise worship
- [Nonstops](https://djmusta.com/nonstops) — Ugandan mixtapes and nonstop mixes

## Content

All songs on DJ Musta are uploaded by artists or with their permission. Each song includes title, artist name, genre, cover art, and an MP3 stream. Songs can be streamed free or downloaded with embedded ID3 tags.
